_comment: Cube directory. id is the CubeCobra ID (short or UUID); link target is https://cubecobra.com/cube/list/<id>. nameOverride replaces the CubeCobra name when set (group nicknames). strategy is hand-curated, not auto-generated. pinned cubes sort first; the rest sort alphabetically by display name. thumbnail is an optional community-art image path; when null, try pulling art from the CubeCobra API.

cubes.strategy: Leans into combo and synergy over classic Vintage archetypes (e.g. Doomsday), and is currently featuring the Initiative mechanic from Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate.
Cross-synergies center on ETBs, +1/+1 counters, and cheating creatures into play.
WR Aggro/Heroic · GB Graveyard · WB Drain/Reanimator · WU Heroic/Flyers · UB Mill/Control · RB Burn/Minotaurs · RG Stompy/Satyrs · WG +1/+1 Counters/Centaurs · UR Burn/Spells Matter
Emulates Commander's splashy, high-variance gameplay in a normal Cube format — expect big mana ramp and swingy bombs.
